not_covered: The available evidence does not contain information regarding "modern control theory," specific theoretical methods/models for grain modeling, or detailed technical content from the cited papers beyond their metadata and titles. [Source: ev-1]

The only relevant details supported by the evidence are:
*   There exists a survey titled "A survey on 3D reconstruction techniques in plant phenotyping: From classical methods to Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), and beyond" published in *Plant Phenomics*.[Source: ev-2]
*   This survey covers topics ranging from classical methods to NeRF and 3DGS.[Source: ev-2]
*   Another study titled "Analysing the phenotype development of soybean plants using low-cost 3D reconstruction" was published in *Sci Rep*.[Source: ev-1]
No evidence supports the application of modern control theory or provides specific modeling/analysis design details for crop grains within these sources.
